title: Envelope
description: Wrapper for every `earmark --json` output and every HTTP API response. Additive fields are MINOR (consumers ignore unknown fields); removal, rename, type change or meaning change is MAJOR.

ok.description: True on success; on false, data is null and error is set.

data.description: Command payload (object, array or null); shapes in board.schema.json.

code.description: Closed set from src/earmark/errors.py. Exit codes: invalid_request, forbidden, identity_required, not_joined, no_board, internal_error → 1; not_found → 2; conflict → 3; empty → 4; busy → 5.

retriable.description: True when the identical call may succeed later (busy).

hint.description: The next command to try, when there is one.

details.description: Code-specific context, e.g. the current issue on conflict.
